grain: One row per version of an account (natural key accountid with a specific effective date), identified by surrogate key sk_accountid.

branches.from: FROM AccountXML AS a INNER JOIN CustomerXML AS c ON a.Customer_Id = c.Customer_Id INNER JOIN ActionXML AS act ON c.Action_Id = act.Action_Id WHERE act.ActionType IN ('NEW','ADDACCT','UPDACCT','CLOSEACCT')

joins: INNER JOIN CustomerXML ON AccountXML.Customer_Id = CustomerXML.Customer_Id (supplied link)
INNER JOIN ActionXML ON CustomerXML.Action_Id = ActionXML.Action_Id (supplied link)

assumptions: Only account-related actions (NEW, ADDACCT, UPDACCT, CLOSEACCT) produce dimaccount rows; other action types are ignored.
The natural broker key CA_B_ID and natural customer key Customer_Id are available for later mapping to surrogate keys sk_brokerid and sk_customerid.
BatchID for the historical load is a constant (1) and will be set by a later formula.
Type 2 attributes (iscurrent, effectivedate, enddate) are derived from the action timestamp and account ordering in a later step.
